exam_scheme.note: AP ECET is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by JNTU Anantapur on behalf of APSCHE for lateral entry admission into 2nd year B.E./B.Tech and B.Pharmacy courses for Diploma holders and B.Sc. (Mathematics) degree holders. Total marks: 200 with 200 objective-type multiple choice questions of 180 minutes duration. In the Engineering stream: Mathematics (50 marks), Physics (25 marks), Chemistry (25 marks), and Branch Engineering Subject (100 marks). Negative marking: None. Qualifying marks: 25% (50 out of 200) for general/BC candidates; no minimum qualifying mark is prescribed for SC/ST candidates.
